notes: The batch threshold avoids parallel-region overhead on small batches; static scheduling suits the similar prior-obstacle scan lengths within a diagonal. OpenMP pragmas require the compiler to enable OpenMP for parallel execution; otherwise the same source remains correct serially.
transformations: Replace dense grid dynamic programming with modular combinatorial counting over deduplicated blocked cells sorted by row-plus-column diagonal.
